items.title: Why AutoZone (AZO) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of auto parts and accessories retailer AutoZone (NYSE:AZO) jumped 6.1% in the afternoon session after the company reported fourth-quarter earnings per share above Wall Street expectations, supported by margin expansion. According to a company press release, AutoZone reported diluted earnings per share of $56.05 for the fiscal fourth quarter ended August 29, 2026.
